note: Curated paralog / segmental-duplication / alt-haplotype family table for the gene_symbol_ensembl_consistent obligation (DR-10). A symbol->Ensembl disagreement is a BENIGN paralog ambiguity (WARN, not a required deposit blocker) only when the claimed and the annotated identifier fall in the SAME family here AND the DE direction/effect is concordant AND the target is not a pseudogene. The families below are the recurrent human segmental-duplication / alt-haplotype loci that dominate spurious symbol<->Ensembl reassignments in RNA-seq quantification; each is keyed to the pinned Ensembl release above. Membership is matched on symbol first (finding_ids of the form DE_<SYMBOL>_<ENSEMBL> carry both) with the Ensembl accession as a cross-reference, so the table degrades gracefully when a release re-versions an accession. Extend per release; this is a curated seed, not an exhaustive paralog map. Ensembl accessions for the less-common members are best-effort at the pinned release and may drift; the symbol grouping is the load-bearing signal.

families.rationale: SMN1 and SMN2 are near-identical 5q13.2 paralogs with OPPOSITE clinical meaning: SMN1 loss causes spinal muscular atrophy while SMN2 is the disease-modifying backup copy. A citation attached to the wrong copy inverts the biological claim, so a within-family disagreement here stays a required failure.
SERF1A/SERF1B are duplicated within the 5q13 SMA region; the copies are functionally interchangeable small EDRK-rich factors.
17q21.31 LRRC37A segmental duplications; the copies map ambiguously and are routinely reassigned across releases.
ARL17A/ARL17B lie in the same 17q21.31 inversion/duplication block as LRRC37A and share the multi-mapping ambiguity.
RABL2A/RABL2B are near-identical duplicated RAB-like GTPases.
TRAPPC2 and its autosomal retrogene/paralog TRAPPC2B encode identical trafficking-particle subunits.
GPR89A/GPR89B are duplicated within the 1q21.1 CNV region.
SLX1A/SLX1B are duplicated structure-specific endonucleases in the 16p11.2 CNV block.
The ZNG1 (formerly CBWD) Zn-regulated GTPases are a multi-copy dispersed duplication family (ZNG1A-F).
The GOLGA8 golgins are a large 15q13 segmental-duplication family (GOLGA8A/B/G/M/N/...) with extensive cross-mapping.

The GOLGA6L golgins are a 15q11-q13 duplication family that MIXES protein-coding paralogs with processed pseudogenes (the -P members). A protein-coding paralog confusion is benign; a pseudogene TARGET of an expression claim is not, so GOLGA6L3P is flagged pseudogene and stays required-fail.

The TP53TG3 (TP53-target-gene 3) cluster on 16p11.2 is a young segmental duplication whose members behave as pseudogene-like copies; expression claims against them are not adjudicable and stay required-fail.
RSPH10B/RSPH10B2 are duplicated radial-spoke-head genes on 7p22.1.
SPATA13 (ASEF2) spans a duplicated 13q12 segment whose copies cross-map; grouped with its alt-locus copy.
EMC3 (TMEM111) sits in a 3p25 region with a readthrough/alt copy that cross-maps; grouped with EMC3-AS1.
